shortDescription: Manage attachment of a storage group to a partition (DPM mode)

options.name: _faked_session
options.description: An internal parameter used for testing the module.

options.name: cpc_name
options.description: The name of the CPC that has the partition and is associated with the storage group.

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: The authentication credentials for the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: The hostnames or IP addresses of a single HMC or of a list of redundant HMCs. A single HMC can be specified as a string type or as an HMC list with one item. An HMC list can be specified as a list type or as a string type containing a Python list representation. The first available HMC of a list of redundant HMCs is used for the entire execution of the module.

options.name: log_file
options.description: File path of a log file to which the logic flow of this module as well as interactions with the HMC are logged. If null, logging will be propagated to the Python root logger.

options.name: partition_name
options.description: The name of the partition for the attachment.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state for the storage group attachment. All states are fully idempotent within the limits of the properties that can be changed, unless otherwise stated: * V(detached): Ensures that the storage group is not attached to the partition. If the storage group is currently attached to the partition and the partition is currently active, the module will fail (this is an idempotency limitation). * V(attached): Ensures that the storage group is attached to the partition. * V(facts): Returns t

options.name: storage_group_name
options.description: The name of the storage group for the attachment.
